concerns.text: Success criterion SC-005 (total execution time ≤ 6 h) is not covered by any task. No task records or asserts the pipeline runtime against the GitHub Actions free‑tier limit, leaving this acceptance criterion uncovered.

The edge‑case requirement for Elastic Net convergence (increase max iterations or raise explicit error) is absent from the task list. T010 implements the model but does not specify fallback behavior if the model fails to converge, violating FR‑003’s full specification.
